neighbours.label: the 'proclaim' word family (Proclamation, proclaimed, proclaim), as against synonyms of announcing and declaring
fire: In 1863 Lincoln issued the Emancipation Proclamation during the war.
The rebels proclaimed a new republic from the steps of the post office.
A royal proclamation ordered every church bell to ring at noon.
The mayor signed a proclamation naming May as Bike Month.
Crowds in the square proclaimed him king after the battle.
The governor's proclamation closed all schools for a week.
The council proclaimed a day of mourning for the miners.
Each year the president issues a Thanksgiving Proclamation to the nation.
quiet: In 1863 Lincoln issued a new order during the war.
The rebels declared a new republic from the steps of the post office.
A royal order told every church to ring its bell at noon.
The mayor signed a statement naming May as Bike Month.
Crowds in the square cheered him as king after the battle.
The governor's order closed all schools for a week.
The council announced a day of mourning for the miners.
Each year the president gives a Thanksgiving speech to the nation.
